attempts.text:
**The window opens on a spine.** Columns 0 to 3, `yjgM` to `tabA`, are carried by 94 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 6% of calls. The model names 57 to 99.6% of them, fewest at column 3, `tabA`, 57%.

**A variable stretch follows at columns 4 to 7**, `arcA` to `yjgH`, carried by 9 to 85%, all shell.

**The model names about as many genes on the spine columns as on the fork and variable ones**, 92% against 92%, and hesitates less there, 0.31 against 0.36 bits. Its most hesitant column, 3, `tabA`, is a spine column, at 3.16 bits.

**The window ends on fork and variable columns.** Columns 71 to 79, `yjfM` to `hflK`, are carried by 29 to 88%, 8 persistent and 1 shell. The last column is `hflK`, in 29% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 92% of genes**, 0.33 bits on average, perplexity 1.5 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.06 against 0.23 bits, and names fewer genes, 75% against 95%.

label: yjgM
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the yjgM window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yjgM, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,863 to 3,942 from dnaA. Read in 536 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yjgM once); 42,879 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.33 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 33,213 calls, named 97%, 0.17 bits; shell 9,350 calls, named 79%, 0.78 bits; cloud 316 calls, named 6%, 3.86 bits. Outside an RGP 37,555 calls, named 95%, 0.23 bits; inside an RGP 5,324 calls, named 75%, 1.06 bits. Columns: 54 spine, 6 fork, 20 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.06 against 0.23 bits) and names fewer genes (75% against 95%); 5,324 of the 42,879 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 3 (tabA, a spine column) 3.16 bits, RGP 6%; column 48 ("acyl CoA:acetate/3-ketoacid CoA transfe…", a fork column) 0.65 bits, RGP 65%; column 44 ("TetR/AcrR family transcriptional regula…", a variable column) 0.62 bits, RGP 34%. The 6 columns (columns 46-51) where most calls are in an RGP: named 89%, 0.56 bits on average; the other 74 columns: named 93%, 0.31 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 54 spine columns: named 92%, 0.31 bits on average; the 26 fork and variable columns: named 92%, 0.36 bits. The model names about as many genes on the spine columns as on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 3, is a spine column: the model can hesitate most inside a spine.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 44-52 (fork and variable columns), RGP 34-65%; the least: columns 0-3 (spine), RGP 0-6%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-3 (4 columns) spine: share 94-100%, all P, RGP 0-6%. Genes: yjgM "GNAT family N-acetyltransferase", rraB, argF, tabA. named 57-99.6% (mean 88%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 3 (tabA), named 57%, 3.16 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 4-7 (4 columns) variable: share 9-85%, all S, RGP 15%. named 89-98% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 6, named 89%, 0.27 bits.

[S3] 3. columns 8-35 (28 columns) spine: share 93-96%, all P, RGP 2-15%. Genes: pyrL, pyrB, pyrI "aspartate carbamoyltransferase regu…", ridA, mgtA, mgtL "mgtA regulatory leader peptide MgtL", treB "PTS trehalose transporter subunit I…", treC, nrdD "anaerobic ribonucleoside-triphospha…", nrdG, cybC, pmbA, yjgA "ribosome biogenesis factor YjgA", mpl, fbp, yjfF "galactofuranose ABC transporter, pe…", ytfT "galactofuranose ABC transporter, AT…", ytfR "galactofuranose ABC transporter, AT…", ytfQ "galactofuranose ABC transporter sub…", ppa, ytfP "gamma-glutamylcyclotransferase fami…", tamB "autotransporter assembly complex pr…", tamA, msrA, paeA, ytfK "DUF1107 domain-containing protein", ytfJ "YtfJ family protein", cysQ. named 62-99% (mean 92%), fewest named at column 24 (ytfT), named 62%; most hesitant at column 28 (ytfP), 0.39 bits.
